doc_leonardo_da_vinci.title: Leonardo da Vinci (Storico)
section_texts: Leonardo da Vinci was an Italian polymath of the High Renaissance who was active as a painter, draughtsman, engineer, scientist, theorist, sculptor, and architect.
His most famous paintings include the Mona Lisa, The Last Supper, and the Vitruvian Man. These are strictly pictorial works on canvas or wall.
Beyond art, Leonardo sketched numerous mechanical inventions, though few were built during his lifetime.

doc_leonardo_inventions.title: Invenzioni Meccaniche di Leonardo
section_texts: Leonardo da Vinci's notebooks contain advanced engineering concepts and mechanical inventions.
Notable mechanical designs include the aerial screw (a precursor to the helicopter), the armored tank, the parachute, and the self-propelled cart.
None of these mechanical designs are considered paintings or artworks; they are purely technical and military innovations.

doc_leonardo_tmnt.title: Leonardo (Tartarughe Ninja)
section_texts: Leonardo, often referred to as Leo, is a fictional character and one of the four main protagonists in the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles comics and related media.
He is easily identified by his blue bandana and his signature weapons, two katana swords.
He was named after the Italian polymath Leonardo da Vinci.

doc_mona_lisa_theft.title: Il Furto della Gioconda
section_texts: The Mona Lisa is a half-length portrait painting by Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci.
In 1911, the painting was stolen from the Louvre by Vincenzo Peruggia, an Italian handyman who believed Leonardo's painting should have been returned to Italy.
Peruggia hid the artwork in a trunk in his apartment in Paris for two years.

doc_vincenzo_peruggia.title: Vincenzo Peruggia
section_texts: Vincenzo Peruggia was an Italian museum worker, artist, and thief.
He is most famous for stealing the Mona Lisa on August 21, 1911.
His favorite tool for the heist was his white worker's smock, which allowed him to blend in with the museum staff.
